data.one_liner: Pure Dart image compression across multiple formats like JPG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, TGA, PVR, and ICO.
data.what_it_does: Downsize is a pure Dart image compression library that reduces image file sizes while maintaining quality. It offers dynamic resizing, format-specific compression, and built-in extensions for File and Uint8List objects.
use_when: You need to compress various image formats in pure Dart without platform-specific native dependencies.
You want to optimize image sizes for web or mobile apps by targeting specific file sizes or minimum quality.
avoid_when: You require advanced image editing features like cropping or filters, which are not the primary focus.
You need a UI component for loading and caching images from the network.
strengths: Supports a wide range of image formats including JPG, PNG, GIF, BMP, TIFF, TGA, PVR, and ICO.
Pure Dart implementation works across multiple platforms (Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux).
Easy-to-use extensions directly on File and Uint8List classes.
weaknesses: Relies entirely on the underlying image package capabilities.
Limited built-in documentation on advanced configuration options beyond basic size and quality settings.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is the underlying package used by downsize, offering comprehensive low-level image processing and manipulation APIs.
